chapter_seo_title: RMJI Ch. 128: Han Li Enters the Cultivator's Market for the First Time
chapter_meta_description: Han Li arrives at Tai Nan Valley and learns he has stumbled upon a massive trading fair for cultivators. Unprepared and out of his depth, he realizes his small pond is now an ocean.

og_description: Wan Xiao Shan explains the social hierarchy of the cultivation world and the purpose of the great trading fair, leaving Han Li feeling like a total newbie.
